title: machine-capabilities
description: NX-062 M3 (ADR-041 §2.4, §2.9): the answer of GET /machine/v1/capabilities, the capabilities one machine key may call now - its scope, intersected with the current machine capability allowlist and the machine client's current grant, computed in SQL at every request (authz.nexloop_machine_capability_list). It is the only source of a machine client's tool list (the MCP client and the SDK never carry their own). kind read is one call; kind write is a prepare and a commit (M5). The description is the allowlist's own text, never a client's. A capability appears only while the client holds an active grant of it (authz.nexloop_machine_client_grants, ADR-041 amendment A1; empty for a client with no grant). Tenant, world and actor are derived from the key by the server and never appear here. NexLoop target contract; server-derived identity required.
